highlights: The other member of the household can now edit varieties she did not create; before, the form was greyed out although a save would have worked.
A photo delete that collides with another save now says so and asks you to try again, instead of Internal server error.
When the frost check itself cannot run, the ops email about it now comes once a day instead of from every afternoon run. A real frost warning is unchanged.
On Snap, the Undo button on the saved card is full height.
